briefText: Design a 2 level advocate chambers on a site 60m x 30m. North is north and frontage is east. Floor-to-floor is 3.6m. Include 1 reception, 2 offices, a library area target of 60m2, and an assembly hall for 120 people. Use public access, library near lobby, style contemporary, outputs PDF and DXF.
constraints: Keep the canonical stair and route evidence authoritative.
Do not infer walls or openings from conversational suggestions.

candidateFeedback.feedback: Keep the public assembly route visible in the technical plan.

proposedRevisions.commandText: Give the main assembly hall a public access.
